# Example Domains

## Purpose
Domains like example.com and example.org are maintained by IANA for documentation purposes. They can be used as illustrative examples in documents without prior coordination.

## Can you register example.com?
No. These domains are not available for registration or transfer.

## Should you use them in production applications?
No. IANA states that web services on example domains are "best effort" and "not designed to support production applications." They strongly recommend not designing applications that require example domains to have working HTTP service.

## Sources
- https://example.com
- https://www.iana.org/help/example-domains
